_notes.purpose: Season Ticket Calculator data for TheDuchessFlame.com. Used by df-bnb-df-calculator.js (mountSeasonTickets) and df-bnb-seasons.js (Scoreboards module).
how_to_update_each_season: 1. Add new item rows to tsv/season_rewards.tsv with the correct seasonNumber.
2. If this is a brand-new season, add a row to tsv/fallout76_seasons.tsv with UnlockRequiredCount, UnlockRankRequired, and UnlockLineText filled in.
4. The script outputs per-season JSON and updates all_seasons.json automatically.
5. IDs must follow the pattern: S{seasonNum}_P{pageNum}_{snake_case_name} for regular pages, S{seasonNum}_B{bonusPageNum}_{snake_case_name} for bonus pages.
6. Pages are '1' through '10' for regular pages, 'B1' for Bonus Page 1, 'B2' for Bonus Page 2.
7. The tally table in the JS counts items from all regular pages and B1 only. B2 is intentionally EXCLUDED from the tally.
8. Even though B2 items are excluded from the tally display, still add tallyCategory to B2 items for data completeness.

item_schema.id: STRING - Unique ID. Pattern: S{N}_P{page}_{snake_name} or S{N}_B{bonus}_{snake_name}
item_schema.page: STRING - Page number: '1'-'10' for regular, 'B1'/'B2' for bonus.
item_schema.name: STRING - Display name.
item_schema.isFirst: BOOLEAN (optional) - True if Fallout First exclusive.
item_schema.tallyCategory: STRING (optional) - Category key for the utility tally table.
item_schema.kind: STRING (optional) - playerIcon, campTitlePrefix, campTitleSuffix, playerTitlePrefix, playerTitleSuffix, playerTitlePrefixSuffix.
item_schema.value: STRING (optional) - The title/icon label value when kind is set.
item_schema.reappearances: STRING (optional, pipe-separated) - Sources where this item is now also obtainable (Atom Shop, Gold Bullion vendor, etc.). Populated by check_season_reward_reappearances.py; exported as a JSON array.
item_schema.addedInRerun: STRING (optional) - The legacy re-release this reward was ADDED in, e.g. 'Aug 2026'. Bethesda adds rewards to legacy scoreboards on re-release; setting this emits isNew:true and renders a PERMANENT gold NEW pill on the card. It never expires - unlike the ~31-day date-driven NEW pill on checklist pages - because the point is to mark forever which rewards were not on the original board.
item_schema.isNew: BOOLEAN (derived, do not put in the TSV) - Emitted automatically when addedInRerun is set. df-bnb-seasons.js keys the NEW pill off this.

_notes.tally_behaviour: The tally table counts how many visible items (respecting the Fallout First toggle) have each tallyCategory, excluding Bonus Page 2 items. It counts occurrences (line items), NOT quantities. Counts update live as the user toggles 'Fallout First Member'.
_notes.js_file: df-bnb-df-calculator.js — see mountSeasonTickets() and the TALLY_DISPLAY constant.
_notes.css_file: df-bnb-df-calculator.css — tally table uses dfcalcTallyTable and dfcalcTallyRow classes.
